input.brief: Abdiel: Computer Engineering UI, DigiLab, discrete logic, Arduino rhythm game, robotics and film; personal workbench exhibition

direction.name: The dark room
direction.idea: One dark field from top to bottom, and in it, lit things. Photographs and objects appear like exhibits in a dim gallery: each with space around it, each the brightest thing on its screen. Type is light, small and sparse. The darkness is not a theme switch; it is a room, and the page is a slow walk through it. It suits subjects sold on atmosphere and material: an evening restaurant, a metal card, a record, a house at dusk.
direction.composition: A single near-black or deep-toned ground runs the full page with no section bands. First screen: either the name at full width in a light weight along the bottom edge with one dim photograph above it, or one object or photograph centred at 40–50% of the viewport with a line of text beneath at 16–18px. Each later screen holds one or two lit items at a generous size (the main one 40–60% of the screen width) with its text set beside it at full reading size; the darkness frames the items, it does not replace content. Images vary in size but all share the same darkness at their edges so they sit in the ground without frames. Practical details come last in a simple two-column text block. The only solid light element on the page is the single primary action.
direction.typography: Light or regular weights; they glow on dark. Avoid heavy bold, which looks cheap on black. Headings 4–7vw at most; text 16–18px with leading 1.6 and a slightly lifted ink (not pure white).
direction.colour: A dark ground with a tint (blue-black, green-black, brown-black), a soft light ink, a dimmer ink for secondary text, and one warm or bright accent used once per screen at most.
direction.imagery: Low-key photographs: dark backgrounds, one light source, subjects emerging from shadow. Their dark edges should blend into the page ground.
direction.photoTreatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.
direction.richness: Light against dark, and the slow pacing.
direction.pitfalls: Grey text on black fails contrast quickly: check it. No glow effects, no neon accent, no coloured light blobs. A dark page with a bright busy photograph is not this direction; choose low-key images. Dark does not mean empty: every screen still carries its content at a readable size, and running text is a light ink at 7:1 or more, not a dim grey.

hero.name: Inset photograph, crossing wordmark
hero.blueprint: One deep, dark flat field. A tall portrait photograph fills the left 47% of the viewport, inset 20px from the top, left and bottom edges, with a 12px radius and object-fit: cover; it is position: sticky for the length of the page while the right side scrolls. Five text links at 15px sit top-right on a 32px margin, the last of them the single action. There is no logo at the top. In the right half, at 44% of the height and centred on that half's own axis, one supporting sentence in the light ink at 24px on up to three lines, max 26ch. Along the bottom runs the name in lowercase at clamp(120px, 12vw, 200px), light or regular weight, tracking -0.04em, on one line. It starts over the photograph's lower-right corner, overlapping the image by about 10% of the viewport width (z-index above it; mix-blend-mode: difference keeps the letters legible on the picture), and ends flush with the right margin, its baseline 40px above the bottom edge.
hero.mobile: The photograph takes the top 58% of the screen, inset 12px, with the same radius. The name runs under it at 21vw on one line, its ascenders overlapping the photograph's bottom edge by 3vw. The sentence follows at 17px, left-aligned on a 20px margin. Links reduce to a menu word and the action on the top row, set over the photograph.
hero.headline: The name in lowercase on one line, up to 9 characters at this size; a longer name drops to 9vw.

photos.title: People
photos.note: figures, silhouettes and portraits, mostly unposed
photos.treatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.

motion.name: Scaling wordmark
motion.description: The giant name responds to the scroll: as the first screen leaves, the wordmark scales down a few percent (or grows from 0.94 to 1 as the footer arrives) on a scroll-linked timeline, so the monument feels heavy. Travel stays under 8%. Static fallback where scroll timelines are unsupported. Recipe: 'Scroll-linked progress' in references/motion.md, animating `scale`.

sections.name: Title torn at the seam
sections.blueprint: A wrapper about 95svh tall per project holds a sticky stage of 100svh, split at exactly 50vw into two portrait panes of 720×900px, `object-fit: cover`, square corners, no gap: two different pictures or loops of the same project (the whole and a detail, before and after). The project's title sits on the seam, centred on x 720 at the optical middle: capitals in a heavy face at clamp(96px, 11vw, 160px), leading 0.8, tracking -0.04em, at most two lines, in one light colour chosen per project. It is set twice inside the one heading element, the second copy `aria-hidden`, each copy clipped to its own half with `clip-path: inset(0 50% 0 0)` and `inset(0 0 0 50%)`. Directly under it, centred, the discipline and year at 16px and a text link with an arrow at 16px. While a project crosses the stage, the left pane and left half-title travel up and the right pane and right half-title travel down (panes ±20svh, title ±30svh, on a scroll-linked timeline), so the name tears at the seam and lines up exactly when the project is centred. The section's two-word heading sits at clamp(28px, 2.4vw, 36px) in the stage's top-left corner, 32px in. Four to eight projects; the stage releases after the last. Under reduced motion the halves stay aligned and the projects change by crossfade.
sections.mobile: Keep the split: two strips 195px wide running the full height of the screen with the same opposing travel. The title drops to 12.5vw on the seam, at most two lines, with the discipline line and the link under it at 16px; give the link a 44px hit area.

sections.name: Inset panel, shaped portrait
sections.blueprint: A deep-toned panel inset 20px from the page edges with a 12px radius, about 110svh tall, `overflow: hidden`. Left half: a two-line statement of four to seven words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 64px) in a pale ink, top-left with 56px padding; it is the heading and has nothing above it. Below it a photograph of the person or the workshop, masked with `clip-path` or an SVG `mask` to one bold shape taken from the subject (a four-lobed flower, a circle, an arch, a chamfered block), 38vw across, positioned so the panel's bottom edge crops its lowest fifth. Right side, starting at 63% of the width and 56px from the top: two text blocks 300px wide and 64px apart, each a subhead at 22px over a four-line paragraph at 15px; then one solid button in the accent colour. Between the statement and the text blocks the panel is empty. One photograph only.
sections.mobile: The panel is inset 10px and stacks: the statement at 8.5vw, then the two text blocks at full width, the button, and last the shaped photograph at 86vw across, centred and cropped by the panel's bottom edge by a quarter of its height.

sections.name: Visit card on a photograph
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed photograph of the place, 100vw by 100svh, carries one solid card and nothing else. The card is a filled panel in the paper colour, fully opaque, 380px wide with 8px corners and 32px padding, placed in the upper-right corner 60px from the top and right edges (or the upper-left: pick the corner where the photograph is calmest). It holds, top to bottom: a two- or three-word title at 28px in a light weight; the address on two lines at 16px; the opening hours as three rows with days at the left and times right-aligned in tabular figures; the phone number; then, flush with the card's bottom edge and spanning its width, a solid booking button 52px tall. The card may be `position: sticky; top: 60px` inside a taller section so it holds while the photograph scrolls beneath it. The photograph's focal point must stay clear of the card. No heading outside the card.
sections.mobile: The photograph is 100vw by 70svh. The card leaves the corner: it spans the width with 16px margins and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge by 80px, so image and card interlock. The booking button is full width, 56px tall, at the card's bottom.

references.name: Kereliott
references.idea: A quiet house gets a quiet page: one dark field, one typeface, the name set as wide as the screen and photographs left to drift in generous darkness.
references.hero: Very dark green-black field with cream type. A two-line introductory sentence at about 30px sits top-left inside 30px margins; a small cream rectangular button sits top-right. The upper half is otherwise empty. The house name fills the full content width in a flared humanist sans, mixed case, with capitals about 19vw tall, its baseline at roughly 87% of the viewport height. Immediately beneath, separated by a gap of a few pixels, the top sliver of a full-width landscape photograph enters from the bottom edge.
references.type: A single face, Trust, in regular weight: a humanist sans with flared terminals and old-style figures. The wordmark is an oversized graphic; all other text is one size of about 20-30px plus tiny 10px photo captions. Hierarchy is position, not weight.
references.colour: #161c1a #eae8dc #222926 #1f2926 — Cream on green-black from top to bottom with no accent colour. The map is drawn in a tone barely lighter than the ground, so photographs supply all the colour.
references.imagery: Natural-light photos of a stone cottage, garden and deck with square corners, in mixed portrait and landscape crops at differing sizes. One full-width opener, then small images placed singly with tiny captions under the left corner.
references.layout: 30px margins, text held to the left 60% in one size. Photographs are staggered left and right at different widths with large dark gaps between, like pictures passed on a wall. The name and a booking button stay fixed in the top corners.

sections.description: A full-width landscape photograph runs margin to margin directly under the wordmark, followed after a gap by a four-line paragraph in the single text size, left-aligned and spanning about 85% of the width. There is no heading or label; the text simply continues the sentence begun at the top of the page.

After a left-aligned paragraph, a silhouette map of the region sits centre-left, about half the viewport wide, filled in a green only a few percent lighter than the background. Five towns are marked with small ring dots and tiny labels; only the house's town has a solid cream dot. No border, legend or frame.

Photographs are placed one or two per screen in a stagger: a portrait image about 30% wide against the left margin, a larger near-square one starting lower against the right margin, later a landscape image top-right of centre and a smaller one bottom-left. Each has a 10px caption under its left corner. More than half of every screen is empty dark ground.

Two short left-aligned sentences in the standard text size with underlined inline links to booking platforms and an email address, then a small cream certification badge. The footer is a single line at the very bottom: social link left, copyright centre, three underlined utility links right, with a tall empty gap above.

steal: Size the wordmark to fill the content width exactly and let the first photograph tuck directly under its baseline.
Draw a location map as a tone-on-tone silhouette with one filled dot among ring dots.
Use a single typeface in one weight and essentially one text size, creating hierarchy through placement and emptiness.

references.name: Deeo Studio
references.idea: The studio's four letters as huge extruded iridescent 3D blocks tumbling across a black stage, with a quiet ultralight serif statement underneath.
references.hero: Near-black viewport. Four extruded 3D letters, each roughly 45-60% of the viewport tall, are scattered at different depths and tilts across the top 80% of the screen: one cropped by the top-left corner, one lower and left of centre, a larger one upper-right, the last cropped by the right edge. Faces are dark glass; edges catch lilac, orange and holographic rainbow light. Over them runs a slim nav: bold caps wordmark top-left at a 60px margin, three small caps links (one with a tiny yellow tag) and an outlined rounded button top-right. Bottom-left, a light serif headline at about 72px begins and is cut by the fold after two lines.
references.type: PP Editorial New Ultralight for the statement headline at about 5vw; PP Neue Montreal Book, Medium and Bold for nav, caps labels and project titles; Inter 14px body. A bold Neue Montreal line reaches 160px (11.1vw) lower on the page. Light serif against bold grotesk is the pairing.
references.colour: #0d0d0d #ffffff #b79cf0 #ff5a1f #f5f5f5 #f0e68c — Near-black page with white type; colour comes from iridescent lilac, orange and rainbow reflections on the 3D letters and from each case-study thumbnail's own palette. The digest records one light grey section.
references.imagery: Extruded glassy letterforms with holographic edge light on black; case studies as square-cornered wide video thumbnails in each client's colours on a two-column grid; one tilted old snapshot in the footer.
references.layout: Side margins of 60px. After the hero come a small left-aligned paragraph and a caps label, then a work list that opens with one full-width thumbnail and continues as two columns with staggered vertical offsets. Every item repeats the same caption row. The footer is centred.

sections.description: The serif headline finishes just below the fold at top-left. Beneath it sits a four-line 17px grotesk paragraph in a column only about 190px wide (13% of the viewport), left-aligned at the margin, followed by roughly 120px of empty black and a tiny caps section label. The right three-quarters of the screen stay completely empty.

The first project is a single thumbnail running margin to margin; the rest sit in two columns with a 14px gutter, the right column offset vertically so thumbnails never align in rows. Under each thumbnail: project name in 16px medium at left with a line of tiny grey caps disciplines beneath, and a small outlined rounded button right-aligned on the same row. Square image corners, no card containers.

A tilted, slightly warped 1990s snapshot with a year caption overlaps giant block letters of the studio name set in dark grey barely lighter than the background, each letter several hundred pixels tall. Below, a centred row of five small links and a single centred line of the light serif at about 28px with a tiny speaker icon.

steal: Render the studio name as separate 3D letters at different depths and tilts, cropped by the viewport edges, instead of a flat wordmark.
Pair the loud hero object with an ultralight serif statement at bottom-left and a deliberately tiny, narrow paragraph, leaving most of the next screen empty.
Caption every work thumbnail with the same two-ended row: name and disciplines left, small outlined button right.

references.name: HAOQI.DESIGN
references.idea: A design engineer's page built like an instrumented canvas: visible construction grid with crosshairs, live coordinates and clock, and a glossy 3D greeting that plays with the cursor.
references.hero: Deep cobalt field with soft darker diagonal blurs. Faint guide lines divide the screen into three columns and three rows, with small plus marks at intersections. Top row: wordmark left, four mono nav items right. Second row: a two-line role title left, a two-line mono motto centre, a four-line mono bio right. Centre: glossy inflated 3D script reading hello, about 60% of viewport width, with a 3D cursor arrow lower right. The headline, three uppercase lines of wide bold sans at 5.6vw, is flush left in the lower third and tucks under the lettering. Bottom edge: mono time and weather left, cursor coordinates centre, globe icon right.
references.type: A wide bold sans (digest name 'tiktok') in uppercase for the 80px headline and closing statement; a regular cut at about 34px for the about text; tronica-mono and a system mono at 12 to 16px for nav, bio, captions and readouts. Three clear sizes; mono does half the talking.
references.colour: #0f1111 #07144a #ffffff #2a3fe0 #c6f432 — The hero is a saturated cobalt field with tone-on-tone blue 3D; everything after sits on blue-black with white text. Lime appears only as tiny tags and scramble glyphs; project tiles bring their own colours.
references.imagery: Glossy tone-on-tone 3D lettering and cursor in the hero; a square portrait with teal rim light; project thumbnails as square-cornered tiles of UI shots, icon sheets and posters; a neon radial line burst in the footer.
references.layout: A fixed frame of hairline columns with crosshair ticks persists behind every section, as do the corner readouts. Content snaps to those columns: about text spans the right two-thirds, work tiles occupy one or two columns at irregular heights with deliberately empty cells.

sections.description: Blue-black background with the guide grid showing. A square portrait about 12% of viewport width sits at the top of the first column, with a handwritten lime signature scrawled across its top-left corner. Starting at the second column line, a paragraph at about 2.4vw in regular sans runs four lines in white, followed by a second paragraph in mid-grey where only linked product names are white and underlined. No heading or label.

Tiles snap to the guide grid but vary in span and height: one wide tile covering two columns, then pairs of single-column tiles, with whole cells left empty so rows stagger. Tiles are square-cornered images on black or pastel grounds. Under each, a mono caption row at about 10px: project name left, year and a category with arrow right. Some tiles carry a small lime tag flush to the top-right corner.

Full-viewport black panel filled with a radial burst of thin neon lines in cyan, violet and magenta streaking outward from centre like a warp tunnel. Centred on top, a three-line uppercase statement in the wide bold sans at about 5.5vw, white, tightly leaded. The grid lines, nav and corner readouts remain overlaid at the edges.

steal: Leave the layout grid visible as hairlines with plus marks at intersections and snap every block to it, so the scaffolding becomes the ornament.
Put live readouts (local time, temperature, cursor x and y) in the corners in mono to make a static page feel instrumented.
Render the hero object in the same hue as the background so it reads through gloss and shadow rather than colour contrast.
references.media: One fixed Three.js canvas covers 100% of the fold and stays behind the whole page, its scene changing by chapter: blue silk with an inflated 3D word about 60% of the width and a 3D pointer, a near-black ground under the work, a warp-speed tunnel for the manifesto. The pictures are a square portrait with a signature drawn over its corner and about twelve project images in a staggered mosaic of 315, 537 and 870px cards hung from either side of a grid column; no video.
references.motion: After a 6.6s load the claim decodes line by line from random lime glyphs into white letters, still unfinished at 4.5s, and the bio types in at 0.23s per character behind a blinking caret. Lenis moves the DOM over the fixed canvas: the pointer moves to a new place per chapter, the signature draws stroke by stroke on cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1), work cards fade up from a grey placeholder over 0.5s, and the manifesto title holds while its last line swaps; 4 reduced-motion rules.
